I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden.  We added 2 railway sleepers at the back for a little flower bed. Then a thick layer of top soil was spread and we rolled out the turf. Then we moved 4 tonnes of hardcore to the back through the house!  Backbreaking stuff.  Thanks to my pal @Wagwarn Abel for jumping on and giving me a hand 🙏 This is obviously unfinished but I think the owner was going to slab the rest himself, so our job is done here for now! As always I wanna know what would YOU do now? There's a bed at the back that's totally empty!  I read and appreciate any comments and genuinely like reading your suggestions🙏 Thanks so much for watching anyway, follow if you haven't already for more vids like this!! ✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.
